info.name: RazorpayX Payroll
info.description:
## RazorpayX Payroll (Opfin) API documentation

All API requests are JSON requests, with three section - `auth`, `request` and `data`.

1. `auth` - Requires two keys - `id` and `key`. Both of these can be obtained from Opfin under Settings > API.

2. `request` - This has two keys - `type` and `sub-type`. Please see the examples below.

3. `data` - Depending on your request, you might need to supply certain data which should be included in this section.

Instead of the `deduction-amount` key, you can also specify a `deduction-days` key and enter the number of days of pay that has to be deducted as the value for that key. In that case, Opfin will automatically calculate the deduction amount using the formula

Deduction amount = [Deduction days] * [Monthly salary] / [Number of days in the month]

item.description:
This API will let you take the following actions for any specific payroll month -

- View an employee's payroll information.
    
- To add additions to an employee's payroll (like bonuses etc).
    
- To add deductions to an employee's payroll (like loss of pay etc).
    
- To reset an employee's payroll (remove all additions and deductions).
    
- To pause/resume an employee's payroll.
    

Identifier options: You can either use the `employee-id` attribute or the `email` attribute within the data field as identifiers for the user. We would recommend using the email attribute as demonstrated in the example. If you need to use the `employee-id`attribute, in the data field you can replace the `email` attribute with `employee-id` and the value as an integer value like so,  
`"employee-id" : 212`

request.description:
Used to create a new payment to a contractor.

**Request Structure**

- **request**: Specifies the type of operation to be performed.
    - `type`: Always set to `"contractor-payment"` for contractor payment-related requests.
    - `sub-type`: The specific action to be taken, in this case, `"create"` to initiate a new payment.
- **data**: Contains the details of the payment to be processed.
    
    - `from`: Employee ID or email of the person initiating the payment.
    - `from-employee-type (optional)`: Type of the person initiating the payment (`"employee"/"contractor"`).
    - `to`: Employee ID or email of the contractor of the payment.
    - `executeOn`: Date on which the payment should be executed, formatted as `"YYYY-MM-DD"`.
    - `remarks (optional)`: Optional comments or notes regarding the payment.
    - `amount`: Total amount of the payment.
    - `tax`: GST, VAT, sales tax etc.
        
    - `purpose`: Purpose of the contractor payment.
        
        | Purpose | Description | TDS | Tax Code |
        | --- | --- | --- | --- |
        | professional-services | Professional Services | 10% | 194J |
        | technical-services | Technical Services | 2% | 194J |
        | commission | Commission or Brokerage | 5% | 194H |
        | interest | Interest | 10% | 194A |
        | contractor-ind | Contractor - Resident Individual or HUF | 1% | 194C |
        | contractor-other | Contractor - Others | 2% | 194C |
        | rent-land | Rent of land/building/furniture/fitting | 10% | 194I |
        | rent-plan | Rent of plant and machinery | 2% | 194I |
        | reimb-no-tds | Reimbursement / No TDS | 0% |  |
        

You can also add attachments (invoices etc) to the payment by including an `attachments` array in the data section. Each attachment should have a `fileName` and `fileContent` key. `fileContent` should have the contents of the file, encoded in base64. Example -

```
"attachments": [
           {
               "fileName": "invoice.pdf",
               "fileContent": "AyNT4+CnN0YXJ0eHVPRgo="
           }
       ]

 ```

request.description:
To delete a payment, you need to specify the `id` that you had received while creating the payment.

  
**Request Structure**

- **request**: Specifies the type of operation to be performed.
    
    - `type`: Always set to `"contractor-payment"` for contractor payment-related requests.
        
    - `sub-type`: The specific action to be taken, in this case, `"delete"` to remove an existing payment.
        
- **data**: Contains the details of the payment to be deleted.
    
    - `id`: Unique identifier of the contractor payment received while creating the payment.

request.description:
Use this to check whether a payment to a contractor has been completed or not.

#### **Request Structure**

- **auth**: Authentication credentials required to access the API.
    - `id`: Unique identifier for the user or application making the request.
    - `key`: API key associated with the user or application.
- **request**: Specifies the type of operation to be performed.
    - `type`: Always set to `"contractor-payment"` for contractor payment-related requests.
    - `sub-type`: The specific action to be taken, in this case, `"get-status"` to retrieve the status of a payment.
- **data**: Contains the details of the payment whose status is being queried.
    
    - `id`: Unique identifier of the contractor payment received while creating the payment.

item.name: Attendance

request.description:
`status` options -

- present
    
- leave
    
- half-day
    
- unpaid-leave
    
- unpaid-half-day
    

`checkin` and `checkout` are applicable for days marked as present or half day.

`leave-type` is applicable if you have set up different types of leaves in Opfin. Try value “-1” to see a list of possible values.

Additional note - if your attendance configuration is set to not allow negative leaves, then any excessive leave requests will automatically be converted into unpaid leaves.

Identifier options: You can either use the `employee-id` attribute or the `email` attribute within the data field as identifiers for the user. We would recommend using the email attribute as demonstrated in the example. If you need to use the `employee-id`attribute, in the data field you can replace the `email` attribute with `employee-id` and the value as an integer value like so,  
`"employee-id" : 212`

request.description:
This API can be used to get the attendance records for a user on a given date

**Note:** In the fields returned, all the fields prefixed with 'requested' are fields that imply a request has been made, but is yet to be approved. Once approved, they will show up as the actual status/leave-type/time. If rejected, they will be set back to null.

response.name: Fetch

request.description:
Use this API to edit an existing attendance record.

`status` options -

- present
- leave
- half-day
- unpaid-leave
- unpaid-half-day
    

`checkin` and `checkout` are applicable for days marked as present or half day.

`leave-type` is applicable if you have set up different types of leaves in Opfin. Try value “-1” to see a list of possible values.

Additional note - if your attendance configuration is set to not allow negative leaves, then any excessive leave requests will automatically be converted into unpaid leaves.

| **Data Field** | **Requirement** |
| --- | --- |
| `employee-id` | `required` |
| `employee-type` | `required` |
| `date` | `required` |
| `status` | `optional` |
| `leave-type` | `optional` |
| `checkin` | `optional` |
| `checkout` | `optional` |
| `remarks` | `optional` |
